title: Engine migration — Astro → Rust core + TS/Vite frontend, one global agentks install
description: Move the engine off Astro onto a Rust engine shared with the CLI, serving a Vite single-page app over one WebSocket. agentks becomes tool + engine + published frontend, installed once per machine. Phase 1 renders, Phase 2 adds editing and the dev toolkit, Phase 3 is a static export for publishing. Includes the config simplification, the ~/.agentks home and build cache, the agentks rename, forced migrations, dropping custom layouts, and narration audio for video pages. Discussion stage: decisions and open questions live in notes/01_initial_discussion/.
author: claude
